entities.name: Arek
entities.description: An Auriok native to New Phyrexia inspired to serve Sheoldred, secretly bearing Phyrexian script on her skin.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Phyrexian leader whom Arek desires to serve.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane Arek is native to.

entities.name: Auriok
entities.description: People with golden hexagonal skin plates.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion whose survival by Arek is unknown.

events.summary: Arek sees Sheoldred's coliseum and is seized with the desire to serve her.
events.quote: Her entire being was seized with the desire to serve her Thane.

relations.quote: Arek is an Auriok native to New Phyrexia who became inspired to serve Sheoldred .
